references.text: The Lord declares that he has taken the Levites from the Israelites in place of all the firstborn, and that the Levites shall belong to him.
The Levites are to be taken for the Lord in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites.
The Lord commands that the Levites be taken in place of the firstborn, and that the Levites shall be his.
The Levites are to be set apart from the Israelites and cleansed.
Moses reminds that the God of Israel has separated the Levites from the congregation of Israel to bring them near to himself.
The Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the Lord's covenant and to stand before the Lord.
Every firstborn is to be consecrated to the Lord, which forms the basis for taking the Levites in place of the firstborn.
Israel shall be holy to the Lord, for he has set them apart from the peoples to be his—the same principle of separation.
